content: DSR implementation pitfalls beyond RESEARCH.md's coverage: (1) failing to log the running trial count as candidates are tried, making the deflation retroactively unreliable; (2) treating statistical (DSR) and implementation risk (backtest-engine-specific numerical differences: fill timing, rounding, corporate-action/gap handling) as the same risk - a strategy can pass DSR yet still produce materially different results in a different simulator; (3) not adjusting for skew/kurtosis (non-normal returns inflate naive Sharpe significance); (4) Harvey/Liu/Zhu argue industry-wide multiple testing means a t-stat of 2.0 is too low a bar, ~3.0 is more defensible - relevant context for setting the DSR/PBO threshold in Gate 2.
